steps.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input 1 is the current approved Minsu character to EDIT. Input 2 is the player's original illustration, the authoritative LINE ART STYLE reference.
Task: re-ink the entire Minsu drawing to match Input2's BOLD, SOLID, CLEAN WARM GRAY-BROWN lines. This is a line-art finish correction ONLY, not a character redesign.
- Current Minsu outlines are too thin. Increase the outside silhouette stroke and important internal strokes substantially, about 1.4–1.5 times their present width (target ~8–9px outside strokes at a 630px illustrated character height), so at the same character height the line weight matches the hoodie character in Input2. Clean rounded line ends, confidently connected contours, no skinny hairline outlines. Apply consistently to hair perimeter, ears, jaw, sleeves/hands, shirt sides/hem, trouser legs and shoes. Interior strand/seam lines also use the same cohesive medium-bold weight, slightly lighter than outside edges as in Input2.
- ALL outline stroke cores are one uniform muted gray-brown, approximately #4C3F3B, matched to sampled protagonist outer stroke cores (#483C38 to #4C3F3B). No patchy red/black/orange segments. No speckles, dithering, grain, mottled tint, dry-brush gaps, multiple sketch lines, ghost edges, jagged pixels, or color gradients INSIDE the ink. The mouth remains a tiny curved line in soft brown #9F7362 (not red). Edge antialiasing is clean and smooth, not fuzzy. Do not outline around the whole sprite with an extra sticker border: re-ink each contour and internal shape.
- Preserve the soft cozy hand-painted look of Input2 with clean matte fills and a few gentle broad shadows. Do not add crosshatching, glitter hair highlights, scratchy detail or vector-art gloss. Remove the current busy short reflective streaks in the hair; use simple broad hair lock lines like Input2 while preserving the EXACT current hair silhouette and fringe shape.
LOCK ALL DESIGN: same Minsu face/eyes/smile and eye placement, tidy rounded black hair and subtly light down-fringe, same smaller regular-fit black-white plaid shirt, same visible white T-shirt, same blue pants/shoes, same height and body proportions, same 5 directions and spacing. No new hair spikes or cowlick, no changes to cheeks or eye shape, no tightening clothes further, no new items.
Output the same wide five-view sheet with separate full bodies on uniformly flat GREEN #00FF00 for alpha-key import, aligned baselines. No cast shadows, no text or labels. Do not crop any figure.
사용자 최우선: 주인공 원본처럼 확실히 굵고 단정한 갈색 선. 색이 군데군데 검거나 붉거나 자글거리는 선 금지. 일정한 회갈색 한 가지로 둥글고 매끈하게 선화를 다시 그릴 것. 지금 민수의 얼굴·머리 형태·체형·옷 핏은 그대로.

Use case: precise color correction of existing raster art.
Input1 is the Minsu sprite sheet to edit. Input2 is the original protagonist for OUTLINE/MOUTH COLOR reference only.
KEEP EVERY SHAPE, PIXEL POSITION, DIMENSION, STROKE WIDTH, POSE, HAIR SHAPE, FACE, EYES, CLOTHES FIT AND ALL FIVE FIGURES IN INPUT1. DO NOT REDRAW ANY FORM. Only recolor the stroke pigment:
1. Input1's outside contours around skin, ears, jaw, sleeves, hands, shirt, trouser legs and shoes are too RED/RUST/ORANGE. Recolor ALL these contours to the protagonist's neutral LOW-SATURATION charcoal gray-brown, sRGB RGB(76,63,59), HEX #4C3F3B. Saturation should be very low, nearly gray with slight brown. Reduce red dominance, do not leave reddish line segments. The uniform dark neutral brown core must have no speckles, irregular tint or mottling. Preserve the current bold thick stroke width exactly.
2. Input1's mouth is still brick-red (roughly RGB164,78,61). Recolor ONLY the curved mouth mark to a much lighter, less saturated beige-taupe brown, RGB(159,115,98), HEX #9F7362, matching Input2. Do not change its shape/thickness, eyes or blush. The mouth must look softly brown, never orange or red.
3. Keep fills and subtle soft shading, hair, clothes, body proportions, composition and flat GREEN #00FF00 background unchanged.
This is not a redesign: ONLY neutralize the reddish outline pigment and lighten/desaturate the mouth pigment. No added borders. Absolutely no extra expansion of silhouettes. 출력 인물 크기와 두께 그대로. 붉은 테두리만 채도가 낮은 회갈색으로, 붉은 입은 원본처럼 연한 갈색으로 색상만 변경.

Precise localized color edit. EDIT ONLY THE HAIR FILL COLORS in this exact five-view Minsu sprite sheet. Minsu has BLACK HAIR, not brown or gray-brown. Current hair is brownish and must become unmistakably soft BLACK in ALL FIVE views. Use a deep neutral-black base around #252528 to #29282B, deepest hair shadows around #1E1E21 and restrained broad charcoal highlights no lighter than #38373B. No brown/reddish/taupe fill in the hair. No glossy streaks, no extra fine hairs, no added noise. Matte black hair with subtle clean broad shading; hair should clearly read black even at small game size.
LOCK EVERYTHING ELSE EXACTLY: same rounded tidy hair silhouette and same light uneven fringe, same interior strand shapes and current thick stroke weight, same warm muted gray-brown outline pigment, same face, oval eyes, softly brown mouth, skin/blush, shirt and its regular fit, blue jeans, shoes, positions/proportions of all five views. The brown outline is allowed around the black hair, but fill must remain BLACK. Do not darken the eyes, skin, clothing or outer line pigment; only hair fill. Keep GREEN #00FF00 background. No cropping, no extra elements.
민수 머리는 반드시 검정색입니다. 머리카락 채움색만 붉은기 없는 차분한 검정으로 바꾸세요. 회색/갈색 머리 금지. 방금 정돈한 굵은 갈색 선과 머리모양, 얼굴, 옷은 그대로. 다섯 방향 모두 적용.
